title.narrative: URGENT ACTION FUND LATIN AMERICA AND CARIBBEAN 2024 GRANT

description.narrative: Support to UAF is directly aligned with Ireland’s commitment to increase resources to grassroots women’s rights organisations and feminist movements as key actors in advancing gender equality and human rights. Key rresults to be delivered include: (1) Increased access of WROs, LBTQI+ groups, and women, trans, and non-binary HRDs, including HRDs with disabilities, to timely resources to respond to emerging crises and threats. (2) Increased access of WROs, LBTQI+ groups, and women, trans, and non-binary HRDs to resources for collective care, safety, protection, respite, rest, and healing in order to sustain their activism. HRDs in receipt of support from UAF work on advancing and protecting human rights on issues from climate justice, disability justice to gender-based violence and LGBTQ+ rights.
